name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
summary: An isolation exercise for the rear delts and upper back performed while hinged forward.
setup: Hold light dumbbells and hinge at the hips with a flat back until the torso is near parallel to the floor.
Let the arms hang below the shoulders, palms facing each other.
Keep a slight bend in the elbows.
Brace the core and keep the neck neutral.
execution: Raise the arms out to the sides in an arc until about shoulder height.
Lead with the elbows and squeeze the shoulder blades lightly.
mistakes: Rounding the back: hinge from the hips and brace the abs.
Using momentum: use lighter weights and slow the tempo.
Shrugging into the traps: keep shoulders down.
Raising too high: stop at around shoulder height.
